news.text: Welcome to Railfever! Connect the towns of this region with rail and bus lines. Press F1 for a quick guide.
Railfever Transport signs a track access agreement with Blue Valley Transit.
Northern Star Rail opens a railway between Weyport and Ashwick (1.5 km).
Blue Valley Transit starts coaches between Oldwood and Elmburgh.
Citizens celebrate! The first train arrives at Coldden.
Northern Star Rail extends its railway from Weyport to Southmouth (1.5 km).
Blue Valley Transit starts coaches between Oldwood and Weyport.
Citizens celebrate! The first train arrives at Oldwood.
Northern Star Rail starts coaches between Elmburgh and Ashwick.
Northern Star Rail lays a passing loop on RE1 Ashwick – Southmouth.
Blue Valley Transit starts coaches between Coldden and Ashwick.
Northern Star Rail rebuilds Weyport station: 3 platform tracks.
Crimson Express starts coaches between Coldden and Elmburgh.
Blue Valley Transit joins two services at Oldwood Castle: vehicles run through.
Blue Valley Transit starts coaches between Elmburgh and Ashwick.
Northern Star Rail RE1 Ashwick – Southmouth: fewer trains for congestion (4 → 3), operating result $0 a year.
Crimson Express builds a road shortcut between Coldden Old Bank and Elmburgh.
Crimson Express opens a railway between Coldden Heath and Weyport Allotments (0.8 km).
Northern Star Rail starts coaches between Oldwood and Weyport.
Blue Valley Transit joins two services at Elmburgh: vehicles run through.
